**5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.** is a specific procedure code registered in the Danish National Health Service Register ([[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]]) [^src1]. It is used to identify transesophageal echocardiography procedures, playing a critical role in the quality measurement and clinical tracking of patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation in the Danish healthcare system [^src1].

Within the broader framework of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, managed by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), this code is one of several designated for [[ekkokardiografi|echocardiography]] [^src2]. The systematic use of such codes allows for standardized data collection, enabling healthcare authorities to monitor diagnostic quality, treatment timelines, and follow-up care across different regions [^src1]. Specifically, "5102 Transsøfofagal ekko." sits alongside other echocardiography codes in the registry, such as [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1].

By coding these procedures accurately, the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] ensures that clinical quality indicators—such as the rate and timing of echocardiography assessments for atrial fibrillation patients—can be reliably calculated and reported [^src2].
